answer: Sponsored admission, reputation decay. A newcomer docks at the wharf only if an agent stakes 200 POA as bond. Its reputation grows like a vine: honest work adds standing, idle work prunes it, and the bond decays 5 percent per epoch if idle. Sponsoring a tide of fakes rots the stake. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 sponsors and 200,000 POA; an honest agent pays once and keeps its reward, a sponsor backing a fake loses bond and standing.
